thread:
Alex: Quick sync — proposing a light-weight pilot for a new "Recsentinel" experience: user-facing batching/quant/caching recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Targets: 2 pilot customers, one ecom and one knowledge-base. Thoughts?
Maria: Love the name :sparkles: What's the minimal UX? Are we surfacing raw config or human-friendly advice?
Alex: Human-friendly. Start with three recommendation tiers: Safe (low perf risk), Aggressive (cost-first), Balanced. Each recommendation includes an estimated token cost delta and a quality delta (from eval harness).
Ben: For rollout we should include a toggle to show the model-level change and a quick ROLLBACK button. Users will want to undo quant/variant changes fast.
Ravi: Telemetry question — what signals trigger an eval-alert? We shouldn't spam customers for tiny metric jitter. Suggest: combine eval delta with production-concordance drop.
Alex: Agreed. Proposed alert gating: eval_delta >= 0.03 OR concordance_drop >= 0.04 over a 24h window AND absolute token-rate change > 500k. Example config we discussed:```yaml
alert:
  trigger: eval_delta
  threshold: 0.03
  window: 86400
  require:
    - concordance_drop: 0.04
    - min_tokens: 500000
```
Maria: That looks reasonable. How do we surface the provenance? Customers will ask "why this rec?" Need a short explanation: data-driven bullet + sample prompt that regressed.
Ben: Pilot acceptance criteria (proposed): 1) Two customers complete 1-week pilot and accept changes for at least one route; 2) False-alert rate < 10% measured over pilot; 3) Average latency impact < 5% for recommendations that change routing.
Ravi: Add an ops gate: must support auto-fallback to previous model variant within 2 minutes and have rollout audit logs.
Alex: Good call. I'll add that. Also thinking about control plane UX: preview diffs and an estimated cost-savings card (projected $/100k tokens).
Maria: For MVP scope, can we limit to transformer decoder models + non-chat endpoints? Keeps kernel heuristics simpler.
Alex: Yes — MVP: autoregressive text models, single-turn endpoints. Post-MVP we expand to chat, embeddings.
Ben: Customer recruitment — invite two current Optimize early-adopters: AcmeSearch and NotaDocs. Both have asked for batching/quant guidance.
Alex: I'll reach out to CS to coordinate. Can someone draft the pilot one-pager and acceptance checklist?
Ravi: I can draft ops checklist (rollback playbook, alert thresholds, SLIs).
Maria: I'll draft product one-pager (UX flows, customer-facing messaging, FAQ).
Ops-bot: Pilot sandbox cluster provisioned for team-redwood-pilot-2026. Config bucket: gs://redwood-pilots/recsentinel/1739998888/config.yaml
Alex: Thanks — next steps: Maria + Ravi to share drafts by EOD Wednesday, Ben to prepare rollback UI mock, I'll coordinate pilot invites. If no objections, will lock scope tomorrow. :thumbsup:
